grammar.label: reported questions
grammar.meaning: passing on a question somebody asked

explanation.en: A reported question keeps statement word order: 'She asked where I lived', not 'where did I live'.
explanation.uz: Ko'chirilgan savolda so'z tartibi darak gapdek qoladi: 'She asked where I lived'.

grammar.negative_example: He asked where did I work.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekchada savol tartibi o'zgarmaydi, shuning uchun o'quvchi savol tartibini saqlab qoladi.

grammar.label: reported speech — backshift
grammar.form: present -> past, will -> would, can -> could
grammar.meaning: moving a quoted verb one step back in time

explanation.en: When the reporting verb is in the past, the reported verb usually shifts back one tense. Facts that are still true may stay unchanged.
explanation.uz: Ko'chirma fe'l o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa, ichkaridagi fe'l odatda bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi. Hali ham to'g'ri bo'lgan faktlar o'zgarmasligi mumkin.

grammar.positive_example: He said he was tired. She told me she would call.
grammar.negative_example: He said he is tired yesterday.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida zamon surilishi yo'q; bu qoida to'liq yangi.
